purpose: Replace serial full-schedule SHA with a content-binding SHA256 chunk tree evaluated on the existing bounded proof pool. The identity is private immutable device-cache metadata; no proof transcript or AIR changes.

mutation_checks: Each chunk including first and last bytes
qualification.gpu_proof_parity: Pending the batched production binary qualification

benchmark.measurement_scope: One CPU microbenchmark while the basket workflow was active; not quiet medians, actual schedule bytes, or an end-to-end prover speedup.

binding.algorithm: Domain-separated SHA256 chunk tree with ordered leaf hashes; each leaf includes segment ordinal, chunk ordinal, segment byte length and chunk length. Root includes version, fixed chunk size, all three segment lengths and total leaf count.
